records.purpose: Copy at most 64 stored-item records for a session-local container into caller-owned storage; count is capacity in and copied count out, total_seen reports omitted items and generation identifies the provider snapshot. Quantity is positive; volume is meaningful only with VOLUME_KNOWN. No engine pointers or mutation cross the ABI.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*snapshot)(sco_plugin* self, uint64_t container_id, sc_container_snapshot* out);`
Copy at most 64 stored-item records for a session-local container into caller-owned storage; count is capacity in and copied count out, total_seen reports omitted items and generation identifies the provider snapshot. Quantity is positive; volume is meaningful only with VOLUME_KNOWN. No engine pointers or mutation cross the ABI.
records.ownership: Caller owns output; provider receives service-owned scratch storage only. IDs are session-local, no pointers retained.
records.reentrancy: Recursive provider reads fail with FAILED.
records.results: OK snapshot; BAD_ARG invalid handle, id, output size or capacity; WRONG_THREAD off game thread; NOT_FOUND unknown container; UNAVAILABLE unbound or stopping; FAILED malformed provider or exception. Known output prefix is cleared on failure, future caller tail untouched.
records.absent_capability: game.inventory.contents.read defaults OFF; no native engine adapter. Synthetic evidence only, not run in game.
records.cleanup: Service stop withdraws table and drops host-owned backend references. Read-only, no engine state to restore.
limitations: No native game adapter or in-game evidence.
No mutation, paging, persistent identifiers or C#/Lua route.
